goal: Implement CLI flag parsing, validation, and the main entry point wiring for the Pomodoro timer.
architecture: A contract task defines the `runCLI` signature and `runTimerFn` stub. Two implementation tasks (parsing and validation) depend on this contract. An integration task wires them to the main entry point.
review_focus: Exit status 2 on validation failure (S2, S3, S4, S7, S8)
Error message exactness (S3, S4, S7, S8)
Default durations when flags are omitted (S11)
Flag application to Timer fields (S1, S5, S6, S12)

tasks.title: Contract: CLI Seam
produces: var runTimerFn func(context.Context, time.Duration, time.Duration, time.Duration) error

tasks.title: Implement CLI Parsing - Primary

scenarios.check: Given args '-focus -1', runCLI returns exit status 2
Given args '-focus 0', runCLI returns exit status 2 and message 'Invalid value for -focus: must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.'
Given args '-focus 1441', runCLI returns exit status 2
Given args '-focus 1440', runTimerFn is called with 1440, 5, 15 minutes
Given args '-short 1', runTimerFn is called with 25, 1, 15 minutes

spec_excerpt: The program must validate all three durations (-focus, -short, -long)
defaults apply only to flags that were not supplied
tasks.notes: Handles the first set of flags and basic parsing.

tasks.title: Implement CLI Parsing - Secondary

scenarios.check: Given args '-long 1s', runCLI returns exit status 2
Given args '-short 1441', runCLI returns exit status 2
Given args '-focus 200 -short -1 -long 5', runCLI returns exit status 2 for -focus
Given args '-focus 0 -short -1 -long 5', runCLI returns exit status 2 for -focus
Given no args, runCLI calls runTimerFn with 2int, 5, 15 minutes
Given args '-focus 50', runCLI calls runTimerFn with 50, 5, 15 minutes

spec_excerpt: Validation must check -focus, then -short, then -long in that fixed order
defaults apply only to flags that were not supplied
tasks.notes: Handles the remaining flags, validation order, and defaults.

tasks.title: Wire main to runCLI

scenarios.check: Running the program with '-focus 50 -short 10' successfully invokes the timer engine

tasks.notes: Refactor main in timer_types.go to call runCLI(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout).
